$doc: Frozen acceptance tests (committed red on purpose by /agentic-workflow:plan) are excluded from the `quality` gate's `npm test` and run in the non-required `frozen-acceptance` CI lane instead (ADR-0023). An implementing task's PR REMOVES its files from this list so they join `quality`. This list may only SHRINK — adding a file to hide a failure violates the never-silently-weaken guardrail in AGENTS.md; any other change requires human sign-off per the frozen-test guardrail.
